BiblicalUsage: Oblivious is the word for a people that has forgotten God so completely it does not even notice. Isaiah charges those who forsake the LORD and forget His holy mountain, and the psalm warns that the wicked shall be turned into hell with all the nations that forget God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe forgetting God is the quietest sin and the deadliest, because a nation can forget Him without ever saying so.
